title: Get to know Business Setup: Doctor Availability, Availability Exceptions and more
summary: Tour of Doctor Availability, Availability Exceptions, Currencies & Exchange Rates, Sequences and Mutual Societies: what each screen is for.

steps.title: Business Setup
steps.details: We'll go through Doctor Availability, Availability Exceptions, Currencies & Exchange Rates, Sequences and Mutual Societies.

steps.title: Doctor Availability
steps.details: Without availability a doctor offers no slots on the calendar or the patient portal. Exceptions (vacations, leave) are entered separately. It has 5 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Availability Exceptions
steps.details: Vacations, leave or specific days when a doctor doesn't see patients (or works other hours). They override the regular availability. It has 4 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Menu → Business Setup → Currencies & Exchange Rates
Currencies & Exchange Rates
steps.details: The currencies you work with and the rate used to convert between the main and the secondary currency. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Sequences
steps.details: Prefixes and next numbers for quotes, invoices and other documents. It has 4 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Mutual Societies
steps.details: The coverage plans patients can have; they're assigned on the patient's record. It has 4 guides in «Guide me on this screen».
